scope: All 639 ledger units and all current lesson/question/glossary IDs, source references, and reciprocal links. No original PDF content was available to this audit; no coverage status promoted.

findings.evidence: 25 current lessons have empty knowledgeIds; 23 have no incoming ledger link. Four existing ledger edges reach the other two lessons but are not reciprocal.
findings.action: Inspect source pages against each new lesson, assign narrowly applicable existing/new knowledge units, then update both directions. Do not infer covered from matching source pages.

findings.evidence: All 984 questions have empty knowledgeIds. Ledger has 13 question edges to only 7 unique questions, all nonreciprocal.
findings.action: Review stem, options, correct answer and explanation against source knowledge units. Record verified narrow links in both question and ledger.

findings.evidence: All 692 glossary entries have sourceRefs but no knowledgeIds; group-level lesson routing is not term-level ledger coverage.
findings.action: Reconcile every glossary term and explanation with original index/source entry and explicit knowledge units; preserve native/domain false.

findings.evidence: 459 ledger-content edges have no shared source document/page; this is a screen, not proof of wrong semantics. Broad reference_application units often point to many unrelated lessons.
findings.action: Inspect each listed edge and source section; remove misleading links or add correct narrow source evidence. Never validate links by page overlap alone.

findings.evidence: source-review.json semanticReviewCheckpoint still describes missing egg conditions, glossary coverage, hygiene supervisor, sampling, statistics, cleaning/disinfection, water/pests, additive breeds, labor and fire details, while current tail lessons explicitly teach those topics.
findings.action: Re-review each detailedGaps entry against recovered PDFs and current lessons/questions/glossary; rewrite the unresolved scope with exact remaining facts. Authored presence alone does not close source coverage.

findings.evidence: source-inventory.json and AUTHORING_CONTRACT.md are available in HEAD but not current worktree.
findings.action: Root should restore tracked audit inputs before validators and publication packaging.

findings.evidence: This audit has inspected ledger/inventory and authored data only. Original PDF pages are being recovered independently by root.
findings.action: Perform source-by-source factual/visual review and attach page-specific evidence before marking any remaining unit covered.
